name: Ek Cheez Bolke Chaar Gina Raha Hai CarryMinati
visual_description: YouTuber CarryMinati (Ajey Nagar) holding up four fingers with an annoyed expression in his gaming chair.
usage_context: Used to mock someone who promises one simple point or thing but ends up giving a long list, overcomplicating, or exaggerating.

example.top_text:
Teacher: Only one question for homework
Meanwhile the question: 1(a), 1(b), 1(c), 1(d)

text_areas.description: Situation or setup text explaining someone promising one thing but delivering multiple
